name: Orient Cement Ltd
title: Orient Cement Ltd - 535754 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Document is an Ambuja Cements Q4 FY26 call transcript (filed under Orient's listing), with Orient only a minor part; cost per tonne peaked at INR4,500, FY27 capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 crore and capacity end-state pushed out, with volume guidance of 80 MT in FY27.

utilisation.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

capex.quote: for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR6,000–6,500 cr
triggers.quote: for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores

triggers.label: End-state capacity pushed out to FY30
triggers.quote: the target plans of FY '28, it could move a year or 2, let us say, on a safer side, I would say that FY '30

triggers.label: Cement prices up only ~INR10 in March
triggers.quote: ballpark for the quarter of March, around ballpark INR10

triggers.label: Sanghi 57%, Penna 46% utilisation
triggers.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

triggers.label: Cost peaked at INR4,500/t, INR250 cut targeted FY27
triggers.quote: I would say that INR4,500 safely, I would say, is on a peak basis

guidance.quote: we are expecting it to grow in FY '28 -- '27 by almost, say, 8% to around 80 million -odd tonnes
for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores
We are expecting to hit capacity of almost 119 million tonnes by end of FY '27

guidance.value: INR250/t in FY27 (average), INR500 over two years
guidance.quote: we are looking at roughly INR250 a tonne reduction this year and then another reduction of INR250 next year

red_flags.label: Capex execution delays and breakdowns at acquired assets
red_flags.quote: we did not choose the right contractor for execution

red_flags.label: Cost per tonne above own targets, rising working capital
red_flags.quote: we have seen cost escalation in Q4, more so in the month of March

evasions.quote: I think any guidance on EBITDA will be difficult at this stage
it would be inappropriate from my side to answer anything on that
